book.name: SOHN
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn SOHN

content: Lih me Dierekda nan eh Kamwahl
Eri, emenemen pwuralahng nan eh wasa. Sises ahpw ketidalahng pohn Nahnahn Olip.
A nimensehngie, e ahpw sapahllahng nan Tehnpas Sarawio. Tohnpokono koaros ahpw pokondohng reh; ih eri ketidi oh tapihada padahk ong irail.
Sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo kei oh Parisi kei ahpw kahredohng ih lih emen me dierekdahr nan eh kamwahl. Irail eri kihdi liho mwohrail koaros,
re ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Maing Sounpadahk, lih menet dierekdahr nan eh kamwahl.
Eri, nan atail Kosonned, Moses kihda ehu kosonned me soangen lih menet en koasdi oh kamakamala. A komwi, ia duwen kupwuromwi?”
Irail nda met pwe re men lidipihedi, pwe re en kak kedipahki. A Sises ketin itiekdi, oh ntingiheki nan pwehl sapwellime rekeleng.
A ni arail kesikesihnen wasao peipeidek, Sises ahpw ketida oh mahsanihong irail, “Eri, mehmen rehmwail me sohte dipe, iei ih me en tapihada kate lih menet.”
E ahpw pwurehng ketin itiekdi oh ntingih nan pwehlo.
Irail koaros ni ar rongada met, re ahpw kohkohpeseng wad emen, tepisang me mah ko. Sises eri ketin kalapwukala, oh lihohte me patopato mwowe.
Sises eri ketida, e ahpw keinemwe rehn liho, “Ia irail? Sohte emen me luhwehdi pwe en kedipeiuk?”
Liho ahpw patohwanohng, “Sohte emen, Maing.” Sises eri mahsanih, “Eri, I sohte pil pahn kadeikuhkada. Kohwei oh sang met kohla ke dehr pwurehng wiahda dihp.”]
Sises me Marain en Sampah
Sises ahpw pil mahsanihong irail, “Ngehi me marain en sampah. Mehmen me pahn idawehniehdo pahn ahneki marain en mour, oh sohte pahn weweid nan rotorot.”
Parisi ko eri patohwanohng, “Ke kin kadehde duwen pein kowe, eri, mehkan me ke koasoia sohte mwahn kadehdehda mehkot.”

Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Mehnda ma I kadehdehda pein ngehi, ahpw ei kadehde me mehlel, pwehki I ese wasa me I kohdohsang ie, oh pil wasa I pahn kolahng ie. A kumwail sohte ese wasa I kohdohsang ie, de wasa I pahn kolahng ie.
Kumwail kin wia kadeik nin duwen aramaste, a ngehi, I sohte kin kadeik emen.
A ma I pahn wia kadeik, ei kadeik pahn mehlel; pwehki I sohte kelehpw nan doadoahk wet, pwe Sahmo, me ketin kadariehdo, iei ih me ketin ieiang ie.
E pil ntingdier nan amwail Kosonnedo, ni en sounkadehde riemen ara koasoi eh pwungpene, ih me mehlel.
Eri, I kin kadehdehda duwen pein ngehi, oh Semei me ketin kadariehdo e pil ketin kadehdehda duwen ngehi.”
Irail eri patohwan kalelapak reh, “Ia Semomwen?” Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Kumwail sehse ie, oh pil sehse Semei. Ma kumwail ese ie, kumwail pahn pil ese Semei.”
Sises ketin mahsanih mepwukat koaros ni eh padapadahk nan Tehnpas Sarawio, nan pere me kohpwahn meirong kan kin mi ie. A sohte me koledi, pwehki sapwellime ahnsou saikinte leledo.
Kumwail Sohte Kak Kohla Wasa me I pahn Kohla ie
Sises pil pwurehng mahsanihong irail, “I pahn kohla, oh kumwail pahn rapahkin ie, ahpw kumwail pahn mehla nan dipamwail kan. Kumwail sohte kak kohla wasa me I pahn kohla ie.”
Eri, kaunen mehn Suhs ako ahpw nda, “E koasoia, ‘Kumwail sohte kak kohla wasa me I pahn kohla ie.’ Ia duwe, met wehwehki me e pahn kemehla pein ih?”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Kumwail kohsang pah, a I kohdo sang powe. Kumwail kisehn sampah wet, a ngehi sohte kohsang sampah.
Iei kahrepen ei ndaiong kumwail, me kumwail pahn mehla nan dipamwail kan. Oh kumwail uhdahn pahn mehla nan dipamwail kan ma kumwail sohte pahn pwoson me ‘Ngehi iei ngehi.’”
Irail ahpw patohwan kalelapak reh, “Ihs komwi?” Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Me I ndaiongkumwailehr sang nin tapio.
Soahng tohto me I kak kasalehda duwen kumwail oh pil kadeingkin kumwail. A ih me ketin kadariehdo, iei ih me mehlel; ihete me I pahn koasoia ong sampah: mehkan me I rongasangehr reh.”
Irail ahpw sohte wehwehki me e mahmahsanihong irail duwen Sahmo.

Sises eri mahsanihong irail, “Ni amwail pahn langahda Nein-Aramas, iei ahnsou me kumwail pahn ese me ‘Ngehi iei ngehi.’ Eri, kumwail ahpw pahn ese me I sohte wiahki mehkot pein ngehi; ahpw ihte me I kin koasoia: mehkan me Sahmo ketin padahkihongieier.
Oh ih me ketin kadariehdo kin ketin ieiang ie; iei me e sohte ketin likidmeliekiniehla, pwehki ei poaden wiewia mehkan me e kin ketin kupwurperenki.”
Eri, me tohto me rong Sises ni eh mahsanih mepwukat, re pwosonla.
Aramas me Saledek oh Aramas me Kehnaudek
Sises eri ketin mahsanihong mehn Suhs ako me pwosonlahr, “Ma kumwail pahn peikiong ei padahk kan, kumwail uhdahn pahn wiahla nei tohnpadahk mehlel.
Oh kumwail pahn dehdehki dahme mehlel, oh me mehlelo pahn kasaledengkumwailla.”
Irail ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Kiht kadaudok en Eipraam, oh se saikinte wia lidun emen sang mahs kohdo. Ia wehwehn omwi mahsen, ‘Kumwail pahn saledekla?’”
Sises ahpw ketin mahsanihong irail, “I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: mehmen me kin wiahda dihp, iei ih me lidun dihp.
Oh ladu men kaidehn towe mehlel en peneinei ehu kohkohlahte. Ahpw wahnedin peneinei men, iei ih me uhdahn tohn peneinei kohkohlahte.
Eri, ma Sapwellimeo pahn kasaledengkumwailla, kumwail uhdahn pahn saledekla mehlel.
I dehdehki me kumwail kadaudok en Eipraam kei, a kumwail ahpw kin song en kemeiehla, pwehki amwail sohte men peikiong ei padahk kan.
I kin koasoakoasoia mehkan me Sahmo ketin kasalehiongieier, ahpw kumwail kin wia mehkan me samamwail ko padahkihongkumwailehr.”
Irail ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Samat, iei Eipraam.” Sises eri ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ma kumwail uhdahn nein Eipraam, kumwail pahn wiewia soangen doadoahk kan me e wiahier.
Ahpw iet me I wiadahren: I kin padahkihong kumwail mehkan me mehlel me I rongasangehr Koht. Ahpw kumwail kin songosong en kemeiehla. Eipraam sohte wia soahng wet!
Kumwail kin wiewia mehkan me samamwailo wiadahr.” Irail ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Kaidehn kiht ipwin nenek kei; Samat metehmen, Koht kelehpw.”
Sises ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Ma uhdahn samamwail Koht, kumwail pahn poakohng ie, pwe I kohdo sang rehn Koht, oh iet ngehi. I sohte kohkihdo pein ei manaman, ahpw ih me ketin kadariehdo.
Dahme kahrehda kumwail sohte kin wehwehki mehkan me I koasoia? Kaidehn pwehki amwail sohte kak rong ei padahk?

Kumwail kadaudok en Tepil, pwehki iei ih samamwail, oh kumwail kin nantihong kapwaiada mehkan me samamwailo kin inengieng. Sangete nin tapio, ih sounkamaramas emen. E sohte kin miniminiong me mehlelo, pwehki me mehlelo sohte mi reh. Ni ahnsou me e kin koasoia likamw, e kin wiewiahte me e ahnlahr, pwehki ih likamw men, oh pil semen soangen likamw koaros.
A iet kahrepen amwail sohte kin pwoson ie, pwehki ei kin padahkihong kumwail duwen mehkan me mehlel.
Ihs nanpwungamwail me kak kadehdehda duwen dihp ehu me I wiadahr? Eri, ma I kin padahkihong kumwail mehkan me mehlel, a dahme kahrehda kumwail sohte kin pwosonkin ie?
Mehmen me tepsang rehn Koht kin rong sapwellimen Koht mahsen kan. Ahpw kumwail sohte tepsang rehn Koht, iei me kahrehda amwail sohte kin men rong ie.”
Sises oh Eipraam
Mehn Suhs ako ahpw sapeng Sises, patohwan, “Kaidehn kiht me pwung ni at koasoia me kowe mehn Sameria men oh ngehn suwed mie rehmwi?”
Sises eri ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Sohte ngehn suwed rehi. I kin wauneki Semei, a kumwail sohte kin waunekin ie.
I sohte kin pein rapahki wauwi. A mie emen me kin raparapahki wauwi, oh iei ih me kin pwungkin ie.
I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: mehmen me kin kapwaiada ei padahk kan sohte pahn mehla.”
Mehn Suhs ako ahpw patohwanohng, “Eri, met se eseier ni mehlel me ngehn suwed mie rehmw. Eipraam melahr, oh soukohp ako pil melahr; a ke nda, ‘Mehmen me kin kapwaiada ei padahk kan sohte pahn mehla.’
Samat Eipraam melahr. Ia duwe, ke lemeleme me ke lapalapasang Eipraam? Oh soukohp ako pil melahr. Ihs me ke wiahki pein kowe?”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Ma I pahn kawauwih pein ngehi, ei wahu pahn mwahl. Semei, iei ih me kin waunekin ie, iei ih me kumwail kin nda ih amwail Koht.
Kumwail saikinte esehda ih, ahpw ngehi me ese ih. Ma I pahn koasoia me I sehse ih, eri, I me likamw duwehte kumwail. Ahpw I ese ih oh I pil kin peikiong sapwellime mahsen kan.
Samamwail Eipraam perenkihda eh pahn kilang ei rahn. Eri, e kilangehr oh perenkidahr.”
Mehn Suhs ako eri patohwanohng, “Ke saikinte sounpar limeisek, a ke kilangehr Eipraam?”
Sises ahpw sapeng irail, mahsanih, “I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: mwohn Eipraam eh ipwidi ‘Ngehi Iei’
ih me mieier.”
Irail eri rik takai pwe re en katehki; a Sises ketin karirihala sang irail pein ih, oh ketieisang nan Tehnpas Sarawio.
